;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Uzbekistan]], [[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**A delegation of the [[Taliban]] [[Taliban in Qatar|political office]] in [[Doha]], [[Qatar]], has visited [[Uzbekistan]] from 7 to 10 August and met with officials at the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Uzbekistan)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]]. Both parties "exchanged views of prospects of the peace process in Afghanistan". [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/taliban-travel-from-afghanistan-to-uzbekistan-for-talks/article24669861.ece (''The Hindu'')] [https://mfa.uz/en/press/news/2018/08/15768/ (Uzbekistan Ministry of Foreign Affairs)]

;Law and crime
*[[List of foreign nationals detained in North Korea]], [[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**A Japanese man is taken into custody in [[North Korea]] with [[Tokyo]] trying to gather information about the case. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/08/11/national/japanese-man-detained-north-korea-government-officials-say/#.W251OuhKi00 (''The Japan Times'')]
*[[LGBT rights in Russia]]
**According to the [[Russian LGBT Network]] campaign group, a 16-year-old person becomes the first minor to be prosecuted under the [[Russian gay propaganda law]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-gay-propaganda-laws-teenager-lgbt-minor-prosecuted-maxim-neverov-russian-network-a8487766.html (''The Independent'')]

;Politics and elections
*Thousands of people protest in [[Tunis]] against a [[Government of Tunisia|government]] report on [[gender equality]] that proposes, among other things, to legalize [[homosexuality]] and to make the sexes equal in inheritance matters. [https://www.alaraby.co.uk/english/news/2018/8/11/thousands-of-conservative-muslims-protest-tunisia-gender-equality-report (Al Araby)]
*[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] [[Chris Collins (New York politician)|Chris Collins]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]–[[New York's 27th congressional district|NY]]) announces that he is suspending his campaign for re-election in the [[United States elections, 2018|2018 midterms]], intending to serve out the remainder of his term. Collins was arrested by the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] on August 8 on charges relating to [[insider trading]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/11/politics/chris-collins-suspends-campaign/index.html (CNN)]
